def transform(g):
    from collections import Counter
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    marks=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=bg]
    rs=[r for r,_ in marks]; cs=[c for _,c in marks]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    M=set(marks)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if out[r][c]!=bg: continue
            perim = r0<=r<=r1 and c0<=c<=c1 and (r in (r0,r1) or c in (c0,c1))
            hgap=False
            for a in range(1,4):
                for b in range(1,4-a):
                    if (r,c-a) in M and (r,c+b) in M: hgap=True
            if perim or hgap: out[r][c]=2
    return out
